resources.string: Turn a spoken agreement into a written record you can both trust.
No agreements recorded yet. Tap the button above to start.
Ask the other person to scan this code with their PakkaBaat app.
Waiting for the other person to join…

By tapping Agree, you and the other person are both agreeing to record this conversation. The recording will be turned into a written summary you can both see and download. Indian law doesn\'t require both people to agree to a recording — but we do, because a record both people trust is worth more than one only one side controls.
I agree to record this conversation
Waiting for the other person to agree…
You asked to stop. Waiting for the other person to confirm…
Auto-stop in %1$d s if there is no response
Saved — this will finish processing when you\'re back online.
PakkaBaat needs microphone access to record the conversation you both agree to.
